title: Report a Pothole or Street Hazard
explanation: Potholes and damaged roads are fixed by the Public Works patch crew. The fastest way to get one filled is to report it through Portland 311, which sends it straight to the crew and lets you track the fix.

title: Report a Broken Street Light, Sign, or Graffiti
explanation: Burned-out street lights, damaged signs, and graffiti on public property are all handled by the city and routed to the right crew when you report them through Portland 311.

title: Report a Dead or Fallen Street Tree
explanation: Trees in the public right-of-way (along streets and sidewalks) are maintained by the city. Report a dead, damaged, or fallen street tree through Portland 311 and it will be routed to the crew that handles city trees.

title: Snow Plowing, Streets & Drainage
explanation: Public Works maintains city streets and sidewalks, plows during winter storms, and manages sewers and storm drains. Their page has plow-route info, winter parking ban details, and contacts.

title: Trash & Recycling Collection
explanation: Portland uses a Pay-As-You-Throw system for curbside trash, with weekly recycling collection run by Public Works. This page has your collection rules, what's recyclable, and where to buy official trash bags.

title: Get or Replace a Recycling Bin
explanation: The city provides recycling bins for curbside collection. To request a new or replacement bin, or to ask about trash containers, start from the Trash & Recycling page for the current request process and contacts.

title: Parking Tickets, Permits & Bans
explanation: Pay or appeal a parking ticket, buy a residential parking permit, or check winter parking bans. Payments and permits are handled through the city's online parking customer portal.

title: Building & Deck Permits
explanation: Projects like a new deck, fence, addition, or major renovation usually need a permit. Portland's Permitting & Inspections Department runs a one-stop shop, and all applications are submitted online through the Citizen Self Service portal.

title: Report Work Being Done Without a Permit
explanation: If a neighbor is building or doing major work that may not be permitted, code enforcement falls under the Permitting & Inspections Department. Start from their page to file a complaint or ask whether a project is permitted.

title: Property Taxes & Assessments
explanation: Look up your property's assessed value, understand your tax bill, or pay property taxes online. The Assessor's Office handles valuations and the city's property tax page handles payments.

title: Birth, Death & Marriage Records; Licenses
explanation: The City Clerk issues certified birth, death, and marriage records for events that occurred in Portland, and handles dog and business licenses. You can request most vital records online.

title: Find the Right City Department
explanation: Not sure who handles your issue? Browse the full directory of Portland city departments and services to find the right office and its contact information.
